_comment: Where to watch, by territory. Broadcast rights are sold per country and change between seasons - treat every entry as perishable and re-check each December alongside the calendars. Only list a broadcaster you have verified against a primary source. The app always tells the reader to confirm with local listings, but that is not a licence to guess. Each guide keeps _sources (territory code -> URLs) from the November 2026 check; the apps ignore it.
